assessments_add_section.description: Add a new section (with optional inline questions) to an existing assessment form template. Useful for building templates incrementally or adding sections to imported templates. Same auto-corrections as assessments_create_template apply to questions.

questions.description: Array of question objects: [{title, type, subType?, description?, placeholder?, isRequired?, referenceId?, answerOptions?: [{value}], allowSelectOther?, requireRiskEvaluation?}]

templateId.description: ID of the assessment form template to add the section to

assessments_answer_question.description: Answer an assessment question by selecting existing answer options or providing free-text values. For SINGLE_SELECT/MULTI_SELECT questions, provide assessmentAnswerIds from the answerOptions. For SHORT_ANSWER_TEXT/LONG_ANSWER_TEXT, provide assessmentAnswerValues with {value, isUserCreated: true}.

assessmentAnswerIds.description: IDs of existing answer options to select (for SINGLE_SELECT/MULTI_SELECT questions)

assessmentAnswerValues.description: Free-text answer values to create and select (for text questions). Each item: {value: string, isUserCreated: boolean}

isUserCreated.description: True when this value is newly authored by the caller (rather than an existing option). Use true for free-text answers.

value.description: The free-text answer content to record for the question.

assessmentQuestionId.description: ID of the assessment question to answer

assessments_create.description: Create a new privacy assessment inside an assessment group. Prefer assessmentGroupId, resolved by name through assessments_list_groups. templateId is a fallback that lands in whichever group happens to be first among those built from that template, so never use it when the user named a particular group. Surface the returned `url` verbatim; never build assessment URLs from IDs.

assessmentGroupId.description: ID of the assessment group to create the assessment in (preferred). Use assessments_list_groups to find available groups.

assigneeIds.description: Array of user IDs to assign the assessment to

templateId.description: Fallback for when no group is known. Lands the assessment in whichever group happens to be first among those built from this template, so never use it when the user named a group.

assessments_create_group.description: Create a new assessment group linked to a template. Assessment groups are containers for assessments. Surface the returned `groupUrl` verbatim.

reviewerIds.description: IDs of users assigned to review new assessments in this group (optional)

templateId.description: ID of the assessment template to link this group to

assessments_create_template.description: Create a new assessment form template with sections and questions inline. This is the "import" side of the JSON import/export workflow. You can provide the full template structure (sections with questions and answer options) in a single call. Question types: LONG_ANSWER_TEXT, SHORT_ANSWER_TEXT, SINGLE_SELECT, MULTI_SELECT, FILE. SubTypes: NONE, CUSTOM, USER, TEAM, DATA_SUB_CATEGORY, HAS_PERSONAL_DATA, ATTRIBUTE_KEY, SENSITIVE_CATEGORY. Auto-corrections: referenceId is auto-generated as UUID if missing or not UUID format; subType is auto-set to CUSTOM when allowSelectOther is true; requireRiskEvaluation is ignored when no riskFrameworkId is provided.

sections.description: Array of section objects with title and optional questions array

status.description: Template status: DRAFT or PUBLISHED (default: DRAFT)

title.description: Title of the assessment form template

assessments_export_template.description: Export a full assessment form template as JSON, including all sections, questions, answer options, and configuration. This is the "export" side of the JSON import/export workflow. The output can be used as input for assessments_create_template to recreate the template elsewhere.

templateId.description: ID of the assessment form template to export

assessments_get.description: Read one filled-in assessment and the answers submitted to it. Given only assessmentId it returns the section list with a question count each, NOT the question text. To read the questions, either pass questionText to get just the ones on a topic wherever they sit, or sectionIds to expand whole sections; every sectionId must exist or the call fails, and reading the form in full means passing every one of them. Reviewer feedback is counted here but read with assessments_list_comments. Surface the returned `url` verbatim; never build assessment URLs from IDs.

assessmentId.description: ID of the assessment form to read. Call assessments_list to look one up by title or status.

questionText.description: Return only the questions whose text matches this, with their answers, instead of whole sections. Use it to answer whether a form covers a topic — "retention", "third party" — without guessing which section holds it. Combine with sectionIds to search inside those sections.

sectionIds.description: Expand these sections, returning their questions, answer options and submitted answers in full. Omit on the first call: you get the section list back and pick from it. A whole form can run to hundreds of questions, far more than fits in one response.

assessments_list.description: List all assessments in your organization. Surface the `url` on each row verbatim; never build assessment URLs from IDs.

assessmentGroupIds.description: Groups the forms belong to; see `assessments_list_groups`

assigneeIds.description: Transcend user IDs the form is assigned to. Resolve names with `admin_list_users`.

createdAfter.description: Only forms created strictly after this date

createdBefore.description: Only forms created on or before this date

dueAfter.description: Only forms due strictly after this date

dueBefore.description: Only forms due on or before this date. Use for overdue.

ids.description: Specific assessment form IDs to fetch

includeDetails.description: Also return assignees, reviewers, due/updated/submitted dates and lock state.

reviewerIds.description: Transcend user IDs reviewing the form. Resolve names with `admin_list_users`.

sortBy.description: Column to sort on; the API offers no creation-date sort. Omit for its default order.

statuses.description: Lifecycle statuses to include. Omit for every status.

text.description: Free-text match on the assessment title

assessments_list_comments.description: Read the reviewer feedback on one assessment — the comments left on it during review. Returns feedback from all three levels at once, whether it was left on the form as a whole, on a section, or on a single question, each row naming what it sits on. Resolution is per thread on the root comment (no parentCommentId); replies close when that root is resolved. Narrow with levels, authorIds, and resolution (OPEN/RESOLVED/ALL). Use this rather than assessments_get, which only counts feedback. To reply or resolve a thread, call assessments_write_comment with the root id, level, and targetId.

assessmentId.description: ID of the assessment form whose feedback you want. Call assessments_list to look one up by title or status.

authorIds.description: Only comments written by these people. Call admin_list_users to turn a name or email into an id, or assessments_list with includeDetails to see who is reviewing a form. Omit for every author.

levels.description: Only feedback left at these levels: FORM for the assessment as a whole, SECTION for one of its sections, QUESTION for a single question. Use QUESTION for "what did reviewers say about the answers". Omit for every level.

resolution.description: OPEN / RESOLVED filter by the root of each thread (the row with no parentCommentId). A reply is open only while its root is unresolved — replies are not resolved on their own. ALL returns both. Default OPEN.

assessments_list_groups.description: List all assessment groups. Groups are containers for assessments and are linked to templates. Use this to find the right group ID for creating assessments. To reach the template behind a form, pass its `assessmentGroupId` as `ids` and read `assessmentFormTemplate`. Surface the `groupUrl` on each row verbatim.

ids.description: Specific group IDs, e.g. the `assessmentGroupId` on an `assessments_list` row

templateIds.description: Groups built from these templates; see `assessments_list_templates`

text.description: Free-text match on the group title and description

assessments_list_templates.description: List the blank assessment templates. Only `PUBLISHED` ones can build new assessments.

statuses.description: Publication statuses to include. Omit for both.

text.description: Free-text match on the template title and description

assessments_prefill.description: Create an assessment form, fill in the answers you supply, and assign it for review in one call. Combines: create form → assign it → read its questions → answer each → optionally submit. Requires assigneeIds or assigneeEmails: a form accepts no answers until it is assigned. The answers are yours to provide; nothing is generated for you. Surface the returned `url` verbatim.

answers.description: Map of answers keyed by question title or referenceId, both of which come from assessments_export_template on the template you are creating from. Prefer referenceId; it survives rewording. A string for text and single-select, an array for multi-select. A select value matching an option text selects it, and anything else is kept as a custom answer, so do not drop a value the options do not cover.

assessmentGroupId.description: Group to create the form in (preferred). Resolve by name with `assessments_list_groups`.

assigneeEmails.description: External email addresses to assign before prefilling. Provide this or assigneeIds so the form can leave DRAFT. They can answer but cannot submit, so submitForReview also needs assigneeIds.

assigneeIds.description: Internal user IDs to assign before prefilling. Provide this or assigneeEmails so the form can leave DRAFT.

includeDetails.description: When true, include one result row per question. Default false returns compact counts.

reviewerIds.description: User IDs to set as reviewers (optional)

submitForReview.description: Whether to automatically submit the form for review after prefilling (default: false)

templateId.description: Fallback for when no group is known. Lands the form in whichever group happens to be first among those built from this template, so never use it when the user named a group.

title.description: Title for the new assessment form

assessments_submit_response.description: Submit an assessment form for review. Optionally specify which sections to submit. This transitions the assessment toward the IN_REVIEW status. The returned `url` points at the assessment-group page where reviewers find the submitted form — surface it verbatim; never build assessment URLs from IDs.

assessmentId.description: ID of the assessment to submit for review

assessmentSectionIds.description: Array of section IDs to submit for review. Required by the API.

assessments_update.description: Update an existing assessment. Surface the returned `url` verbatim; never build assessment URLs from IDs.

assessmentId.description: ID of the assessment to update

reviewerIds.description: IDs of users assigned to review this assessment

assessments_update_assignees.description: Assign internal users (by ID) or external users (by email) to an assessment form. This also transitions DRAFT assessments to SHARED status.

assessmentId.description: ID of the assessment form to update assignees for

assigneeIds.description: Array of internal user IDs to assign to the assessment

externalAssigneeEmails.description: Array of external email addresses to assign to the assessment

assessments_write_comment.description: Leave, reply to, edit, or resolve reviewer feedback on an assessment — form, section, or question. Resolution is per thread on the root comment (no parentCommentId); replies close when that root is resolved. Pass parentCommentId to reply, commentId to edit or resolve a root, or reply with resolved true to close the parent thread. Needs the comment id, level, and target id from existing reviewer feedback on the assessment.

assessmentId.description: Assessment form id (from assessments_list). Dashboard link; FORM edit/resolve defaults targetId to this when omitted.

commentId.description: Existing comment to edit and/or resolve (id from assessments_list_comments). To resolve a thread, pass the root id (the row with no parentCommentId), not a reply.

content.description: Comment body. Required to create or reply; omit when only resolving via commentId.

level.description: FORM, SECTION, or QUESTION — from the assessments_list_comments row.

parentCommentId.description: Root comment to reply to. Not with commentId. With resolved true, closes that parent thread after the reply (replies are not resolved on their own).

resolved.description: true to resolve the thread, false to reopen. Needs the root commentId, or parentCommentId when replying (closes that parent). Replies are not resolved alone.

targetId.description: Form, section, or question id (list row targetId). Required to create/reply; required for QUESTION edit/resolve; FORM defaults to assessmentId.
